one_line: Empty room to finished corner is a clear silent arc, but it needs a person, a reason and readable text.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a tall BLISS box in plastic leans on a wall; 0:02 an empty room with a foam mat; 0:03 a foam block with a round window. No speech. Small thin English text: 'POV: Unlocking 100% core memories at home'.
q1_hook.why: A box, then an empty room, then a set built in it: a before and after that poses a question, what does it turn into (H5). But the only text is small, thin and English over a busy picture (T5, H7), nobody speaks or appears (H4), and it never says what the product gives (H2).

beats.what: A wrapped box marked BLISS leans on a wall
beats.why: A delivery, the start of a before and after.

beats.what: An empty room: a pale foam mat, tall curtains
beats.why: The starting point to build from.

beats.what: A slope-and-cube block with a round window in a corner, then three nested arches
A tower of round poufs, one gingham, shot tilting up
The corner seen whole, an arch by a cube, a top-down pile of cubes
beats.why: Shows how many pieces there are.

beats.what: Blocks form an arch bridge; a hand with a ring touches a castle wall piece
beats.why: The only human presence; shows sturdiness.

beats.what: A finished castle with two triangle roofs
Static wide shot of the whole corner and the castle

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. No question, no send or save ask, no comment word in the video or the caption.
q2_flow.why: A change of subject every 2 to 4 s, from box to room to pieces to castle, builds toward a finished corner, a visible arc (K2, R3, R4). But no child uses it, no one speaks, and the text never changes, so the pull rests on looks alone (K8, H6). Little here is worth sending (R5).

q3_cta.what: None. The video ends on a wide shot of the finished corner. Caption: 'אוגוסט והג'ימבורי הביתי של @bliss.il הוא כל מה שחלמתי עליו!'. No link, code, price, question or comment word.
q3_cta.why: A mood piece with no next step: the brand appears only on the box and as a tag, with no price or where to buy (C6, C3). Nothing asks for a comment or a send (C4, R6). It gives the viewer no reason to act.

q4_shown.what: A BLISS box 0:00; a block with a round window 0:03; nested arches 0:07; poufs 0:08; a pile of cubes from above 0:15; an arch bridge 0:17; a castle 0:19 to 0:24; the room 0:24 to 0:27. One hand at 0:19. No child, no price.
q4_shown.why: The pieces are handled only briefly (one hand at 0:19), and no child uses them (S1, K5). The finished arrangement proves the look, and shapes and fabrics are clear (F4). It shows nothing of what the set does for a child or parent (K8, H2). No child, in line with LumeBook's own rule (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 12 shots in 28 s (2.3 s each): straight cuts, mostly handheld close-ups, one tilt up the poufs, one static wide shot to end. No speed changes seen. One fixed text for the whole Reel. No speech or sound the transcript shows.
q5_edit.why: A cut every 2 to 3 s with a new piece each time keeps a calm pace (E2, R3). The fixed text sits across product details for 28 s and never changes (T2). It ends on a static wide shot.

q6_topic.what: A neutral-coloured foam play corner built in an empty room. Serves a parent who wants a tidy play area that matches the home.
q6_topic.why: The tidy, aspirational room meets a home-design wish (K6), and building is satisfying to watch (K2). 'Core memories' is only a phrase: no family moment or child is shown to back it (K1, K8).

q7_filmed.what: Phone, handheld, eye level: close-ups of pieces and fabric, a tilt up a pouf tower, a top-down pile of cubes, a static wide shot at the end. Soft daylight through sheer curtains. A single hand, no face, no child.
q7_filmed.why: Close-ups fill the frame so shapes and fabrics read (F4). Soft window light and a clean room look careful, not lo-fi (F7, H8).

q8_text.on_screen: One fixed text for all 28 s, in the lower middle at about 70 to 74% of the frame height, two lines of small, thin white English: 'POV: Unlocking 100% core memories at home'. It sits over the product in most shots. No Hebrew, no subtitles, no CTA.
q8_text.caption: 'POV: Unlocking 100% core memories at home' on the first line, then 'אוגוסט והג'ימבורי הביתי של @bliss.il הוא כל מה שחלמתי עליו!'. Two short lines. No hashtags, question, CTA or disclosure word.
q8_text.why: A headline is up from frame zero (T3), but it is English, thin and small, in the bottom 35% and over the product, so hard to read (T5, T4, F2). A Hebrew audience gets little muted (T1). The caption has no search words or hashtags (T7) and no partnership word (T8, S7).

weak_points: English-only thin text over the product; no voice, child or reason; no price, link or CTA; no partnership word beside a co-author; a 28 s Reel that never says what the set is for.
lumebook_takeaway: Copy only the arc: parcel, then the book opened, then a page. Add one Hebrew headline card that states the benefit, plus hands on the page.
not_verified: Whether the creator is a parent or a UGC creator; paid status (label 0, none seen); music (none evident). The 720 x 1280 size is the saved copy. Correction: the text sits at about 70 to 74% of the frame height, and the second shot (empty room) starts at about 2 s.
